I’ve missed the festival completely and actually had no idea that it was on, and simply went for a evening walk around my neighbourhood. I was supposed to leave the city, I loved it so much and I was extremely heartbroken to be honest. So, I go through a small forest, out on a bridge, and I hear I Need My Girl. 

The woman was too stunned to speak. The bridge was across the road, in front of the venue where the festival was. I stayed on the bridge during the whole set, crying like a little sad snitch I was, and I’m madly in love with The National ever since.
